procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the ten pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (banner 'Official Recapitulation General Election'; cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/bolivar/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11, with the X-cells filling 0 under their rows' own printed TOTALs).
structure_note: Ten-page shape: p1 the certification/signature page; p2+p3+p4 = the countywide table over the county's TWENTY-NINE precincts (11 columns Benoit..Eastgate, then Gunnison..Shaw, then Shelby..Winstonville + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 2, CoA 2 Position 1, Chancery 7-1 Place 1, and Circuit 11 Places 1-2; p5-p10 = a LOCAL table over the same column split (county court judge, school boards) whose FIRST row is the carried tail of Circuit 11-2 -- David L. Tisdell, the race's second candidate, printing on p5/p6/p7 with exactly Morris-Harris's X pattern -- so pages 5/6/7 are mixed in-scope/local and their local rows contribute no parse rows. Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins); US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller REP first, then Bennie G. Thompson DEM, then Bennie Foster IND -- the House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- the CoA 2 roster alone, names identical, TWENTY-FIRST county); Chancery Court 7-1-Chancery District 7-1 Place 1 (Catherine Farris-Carter -- the Chancery 7-1 roster, names identical, FOURTH county with Quitman/Coahoma/Tunica); Circuit Court 11-1-Circuit District 11-1 (W. Hunter Nowell) and Circuit Court 11-2-Circuit District 11-2 (Stephanie 'Nikki' Morris-Harris, David L. Tisdell) -- matching Coahoma/Quitman's prints, Bolivar being the STRADDLE county: its two Places' value precincts OVERLAP at five of them (Boyle, East Central Cleveland, East Cleveland, North West Cleveland, Winstonville) where BOTH Places print values -- the sub-district boundary splits those precincts -- and each row still referees to its own printed TOTAL. Printed totals: Colom 7120, Hyde-Smith 2918, Pinkins 110, Eller 2916, Thompson 7022, Foster 199, McDonald 7165, Farris-Carter 7591, Nowell 5114, Morris-Harris 2701, Tisdell 572.
operator_rows_note: All 11 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2+p3+p4 cells + the p4 printed TOTAL, and Tisdell's row carries p5+p6+p7 cells + the p7 printed TOTAL (p5/p6 omit the X-celled precincts, p7 omits the X columns). The X-marked cells fill 0 under each row's own printed TOTAL (all eleven reconcile with the X fills). Tisdell's row is the section-continuation of Circuit 11-2 across the countywide/local table boundary: its section header printed on p2-p4, its second candidate prints on p5-p7.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty-nine precinct headers print complete (Benoit, Beulah, Boyle, Choctaw, Cleveland Courthouse, District 3 Road Barn, Duncan-Alligator, East Central Cleveland, East Cleveland, East Rosedale, Eastgate, Gunnison, Longshot, Merigold, Morrison Chapel Church, Mound Bayou, North Cleveland, North West Cleveland, Pace, Renova, Scott-Stringtown, Shaw, Shelby, Skene, South Cleveland, West Central Cleveland, West Cleveland, West Rosedale, Winstonville -- the sheet's own forms kept verbatim).
local_note: p5-p10 also carry ALL-LOCAL sections: 'Bolivar-County Court Judge' (Ja'Nekia W. Nikki Barton, Aelicia 'Atty T' Thomas) and school trustees (School District C001/C005, North 02/03, West 02, West 03: Paulette K. Howze; George Evans Jr., Chris 'Big Chris' Johnson; Kimberly Brown, Steve L. Carmicle, William H. Lucas Jr.; Tyrone D. Miller Sr.; Bernice Carson-Boone, Major Rice Sr., Tanya McCarty Rodges; Mildred Holmes Lunford, Koronda T. Smith) -- all local, out of scope; the county court judge section is countywide (no X), the school sections X-cell outside their districts, and none contributes parse rows. Chancery 7-1's printed Places are Place 1 only; Circuit 11's printed Places are 11-1 and 11-2 (the Place 3 section is Coahoma/Quitman/Tunica's).
